Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Color.Transparent,
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        gblAppColors.Error,
        gblAppColors.ApprovalClusterStates.InProgress
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",
        gblEnvironmentName = "Prod"
    ),
    false,
    true
)

If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Icon.Information,
    If(
        cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
        Icon.Blocked,
        "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        Icon.Lock,
        Icon.Information
    )
)

If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    "",
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        "Active"
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",
        gblEnvironmentName = "Prod"
    ),
    false,
    true
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
AddColumns(
    Sort(
        Filter(
            colCapexAccounts,
            'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List' = ThisItem.'CAPEX Account List'
        ),
        Order,
        SortOrder.Ascending
    ),
    EditIcon,
    If(
        RecordInfo(
            ThisItem,
            RecordInfo.EditPermission
        ),
        "icon:Edit"
    ),
    ChangeStatusIcon,
    Switch(
        ThisRecord.Status,
        'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Active,
        If(
            RecordInfo(
                ThisItem,
                RecordInfo.EditPermission
            ),
            "icon:DeactivateOrders"
        ),
        'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Inactive,
        If(
            And(
                ThisItem.Status = 'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Active,
                RecordInfo(
                    ThisItem,
                    RecordInfo.EditPermission
                )
            ),
            "icon:ActivateOrders"
        )
    ),
    DeleteIcon,
    With(
        {varThisRecord: ThisRecord},
        If(
            And(
                IsBlank(
                    LookUp(
                        colCapexProjectContracts,
                        Account.'CAPEX Account List' = varThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List'
                    )
                ),
                RecordInfo(
                    ThisItem,
                    RecordInfo.DeletePermission
                )
            ),
            "icon:Delete"
        )
    ),
    RecordKey,
    ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List'
)
